about: Library forms of the 246 cheme and cheme2 questions (PLAN.md, Questions), written 2026-10-31 from each original question, its expect and the paper's pdftotext only, before any answer of this test existed. Edits: table, figure and section numbers removed; 'the paper', 'the study', 'this work', 'the review' replaced by a subject phrase; a subject phrase added where the question would otherwise fit more than one of the 28 papers. Answer keys (expect, trap, must) are the originals, unchanged.
